note: `mayDisallow` is the closed universe of paths robots.txt is allowed to block: every row of plan/02 §7 that says 'robots disallow' or is unreachable-by-design, plus the (dev) route group of spec 004 AC-28. `mustStayCrawlable` is the other half of the same section — URLs whose `noindex` can only be seen if the crawler may fetch them (plan/02 §7: facets are 'not blocked in robots so the noindex is seen'), plus the parameter shapes that carry real landing traffic.
